title: WGPU Backdrop Effects Conformance Harness Follow-on v1
problem: Several backdrop-effect WGPU conformance tests still duplicated the same Rgba8Unorm final-render readback helpers already owned by the shared integration-test support module. The duplication made backdrop effect evidence harder to audit without adding behavior coverage.

repro.summary: Backdrop effect WGPU conformance tests should render and sample through shared test support while preserving Rgba8Unorm transparent-clear behavior.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test effect_backdrop_acrylic_recipe_conformance --test effect_backdrop_blur_conformance --test effect_backdrop_blur_rounded_clip_conformance --test effect_backdrop_color_adjust_conformance --test effect_backdrop_pixelate_conformance --test effect_backdrop_pixelate_rounded_clip_conformance --test effect_backdrop_warp_conformance -j 1

gates.name: backdrop-effects-conformance
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test effect_backdrop_acrylic_recipe_conformance --test effect_backdrop_blur_conformance --test effect_backdrop_blur_rounded_clip_conformance --test effect_backdrop_color_adjust_conformance --test effect_backdrop_pixelate_conformance --test effect_backdrop_pixelate_rounded_clip_conformance --test effect_backdrop_warp_conformance -j 1

continue_policy.notes: The named backdrop effect tests migrated successfully. effect_backdrop_warp_v2_conformance.rs stays out of scope because it owns image registration setup and should be handled in a separate follow-on.
